type get_labute_asa = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Bertz complexity index.
type get_bertz_ct = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_hall_kier_alpha = (_: {

}) => any;

type get_kappa1 = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_kappa2 = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_kappa3 = (_: {

smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_num_unspecified_atom_stereo_centers = (_: {
